harper (pm): Quick sync: I'm proposing a compact acceptance bundle for catalog entries + a clear deprecation/exit playbook. Need cross-team thumbs within 48h.

diego (eng): Sounds good. Minimal bundle = perf artifact, memory/quant profile, canary config, and a tiny smoke-test script. Also include expected cost estimate per 1k requests.

mei (eng-ml): Add quality gate: holdout slice regression <=4% and an eval recipe that can be re-run from the runbook. Also require a reproducible prompt sample file.

kyle (cs): From customers: surface TTL in console and make migrations opt-in. For enterprise tier, propose 90d pin with migration credits and a pre-announcement window.

ruth (legal): Two lanes OK. We'll draft a Partner annex for longer pins. Need emergency-exit clause for critical security/PII incidents and DPA alignment for Private installs. Avoid absolute pin guarantees.

harper (pm): Proposal: two lanes - Starter (30d TTL, self-serve, no credits) and Partner (90d TTL, credits, comms + rollback runbook). Pre-GA deliverables: bench artifact, runbook (how to reproduce tests), legal annex, CS comms templates, infra canary + dashboard.

ops-bot: Note: roadmap-epic PR opened by @harper. CI checks passed. :white_check_mark:

diego (eng): I'll own bench artifact + canary job template. Canary requirements: 48h on reserved pool, error-rate <0.5%, KV-eviction logged.

mei (eng-ml): I'll publish eval harness + sample slices and a replay script.

kyle (cs): CS will draft migration emails and beta invites. Confirming migrations are opt-in? We prefer opt-in.

ruth (legal): Opt-in is fine. I'll circulate the Partner annex and emergency-exit wording.

harper (pm): Acceptance checklist to lock in 48h if no objections:
- Bench: p50/p95 + quality regression <=4% on sampled prompts
- Canary: 48h pass, error-rate <0.5%
- Docs: runbook + migration playbook + CS templates
- Legal: Partner annex + DPA for Private
- Infra: canary job + dashboard with trace-id and eviction metrics

harper (pm): Owners: @diego (canary+bench), @mei (eval harness), @ruth (legal), @kyle (customer comms). Merge roadmap PR if no flags.
